beats.say: Michael Jackson's Thriller held number one for a record 37 weeks.
That is nearly nine months, longer than a typical school year.
The sixth studio album launched on 29 November 1982 through Epic Records.
Quincy Jones returned as producer following their Off the Wall triumph.
Paul McCartney features as the first credited guest on a Jackson album.
Thriller earned eight Grammy Awards, taking both Album of the Year and Record of the Year.
Eight American Music Awards also set a brand new record for any artist.
The groundbreaking video that changed music television lands in Part 2. Which Thriller track is your favourite?

facts: Thriller is the sixth studio album by Michael Jackson.
It was released on 29 November 1982 through Epic Records.
It was produced by Quincy Jones, who produced Jackson's previous album, Off the Wall (1979).
Paul McCartney appears as the first credited featured artist on a Jackson album.
Thriller was Jackson's first number-one album on the Billboard Top LPs & Tape chart and was at number one for a record 37 non-consecutive weeks.
It won a record-breaking eight Grammy Awards, including Album of the Year and Record of the Year for Beat It.
It earned Jackson a record-breaking eight American Music Awards.
